title: Financial Controller - Latam
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.
As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!
At Palo Alto Networks, we believe in the power of collaboration and value in-person interactions. This is why our employees generally work full time from our office with flexibility offered where needed. This setup fosters casual conversations, problem-solving, and trusted relationships. Our goal is to create an environment where we all win with precision.
Job Description
Your Career
Palo Alto Networks has an exciting opportunity for a LatAm Controller to join our Finance Team. We are looking for a financial professional interested in a senior level opportunity as a regional Controller to ensure accuracy and completeness of accounting and financial reporting for the Palo Alto Networks legal entities in the Latin American region and play a key role in re-engineering processes to drive improvement. This position has extensive interaction with cross-functional business partners at all levels, including senior management in multiple geographical locations.
A successful candidate will be proactive, confident and solution-oriented, have a broad set of work experiences within a Finance organization, and will provide a strong voice to represent Finance throughout the Controllership to arrive at solutions all cross-functional groups will find reasonable.
Your Impact
  • Identify actionable insights and drive cross-functional process improvements including, but not limited to, internal and external financial reporting, regulatory compliance, internal controls and system integration in the region
  • Lead the formulation of the Country Controlling strategy for the region to align with business needs and corporate strategy
  • Take ownership of facilitation and creation of accurate project plans with clearly defined milestones, deliverables and tasks
  • Perform monthly detailed reviews of the regional financial statements to ensure alignment with corporate reporting and local accounting GAAP reporting requirements
  • Perform month-end close for the regional entities to ensure accurate US GAAP and company policy compliant financial statements, including reviewing monthly transactions, account reconciliations, and balance sheet and income statements for reasonableness
  • Effectively provide guidance and support to GL resources in the Palo Alto Networks Center of Excellence to improve the quality, timeliness and efficiency of the regional month-end close process
  • Coordinate with IT, global and regional accounting functions, and regional third-party accounting service providers on regional system implementation projects
  • Establish effective partnerships with Palo Alto Networks Global Process Owners, Centers of Excellence and corporate and regional accounting teams to drive the incorporation of global process standards in the region
  • Establish and document all policies, process and procedures localization requirements for the region
  • Effectively manage third-party service providers in region to improve the quality, timeliness and efficiency of their services
  • Coordinate annual statutory audits for various entities in region
  • Review and approve non-routine transactions in the regional entities
  • Ensure controls and discipline are in place to achieve high employee satisfaction within the region
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives in region
  • Ensure local compliance with regional regulations, regulatory filings, and accounting rules (GAAP)
  • Effectively partner with regional and corporate FP&A and People teams to provide accounting insight and support on regional matters
  • Work with cross-functional teams on treasury and tax strategies to support compliance and the corporate goals for the region
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • At least 8-12 years of relevant experience in a medium to large size international reporting environment is required and working experience in high tech companies with prior Big 4 accounting firm experience is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s in accounting or finance – Contador or equivalent certification a plus
  • In-depth expertise, excellent working ability, and knowledge of local GAAP accounting principles, regulatory compliance and reporting requirements
  • Hands-on experience managing the accounting and financial reporting processes for international operations in the Latin American region
  • Experience with SAP or other large ERP systems
  • Proficient in US accounting standards, principles and pronouncements
  • Proven ability to work in fast-paced environments, meet challenging deadlines and priorities, deliver on multiple simultaneous projects and drive changes
  • Problem solver with strong critical thinking and project management skills
  • Demonstrated judgment in prioritizing work, identifying issues and recommending solutions, and managing multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Fluent in English, fluent in Spanish or Portuguese a plus
  • Highly collaborative with a leadership attitude to take initiative to solve problems
  • Highly proficient in Excel and Google Sheets
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively, including cross-functionally
Please submit your resume in English only so that it can be properly evaluated by the Hiring team. Resumes in other languages, including Portuguese and Spanish, will not be considered for the open role.
 Additional Information
The Team
You have a passion for numbers & integration, our organization has a passion for cybersecurity. You’re looking for a career with a more fulfilling mission. We have open positions to top talent seeking a financial challenge. Our accounting department deals with numbers daily, supporting infrastructure, dealing in automation, building solutions and providing accurate, insightful financial information to empower our business lines. The ideal candidate has exceptional skills in accounting and analytics and an innovative mindset to approach finance problems differently. Our innovation doesn’t stay in Research and Development. Within finance and accounting, we seek people who are looking to try new things, while solving business critical equations. If you’re seeking a financial challenge but with a world-wide impact – this is it.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Customer Support Analyst
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.


Why choose Credix?


  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

We are looking for someone to join the Credix Operations team as an Customer Support Analyst. You love serving clients and providing recommendations on how we can improve efficiency and effectiveness across our organization. You understand the needs of the organization and make changes to streamline operations.


Qualifications

  • Fluent in English and Portuguese, both written and verbal.
  • Passionate about the customer journey and willing to embrace a continuous improvement mindset, always seeking ways to optimize processes, improve performance, and innovate.
  • You are open to feedback and willing to experiment with new approaches.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills: you can quickly learn complex systems, break down problems, and develop rigorous and quantitative arguments to inform decision-making.
  • You are proactive and a fast learner.
  • Enthusiastic team player with a strong work ethic, entrepreneurial spirit, and ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical mindset combined with outstanding interpersonal and communication skills.


Responsibilities

  • Spend 90% of your time on daily customer support operations, ensuring a seamless experience for customers by addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and maintaining high service standards.
  • Act as a key user for customer support systems, ensuring smooth operation and effective use of tools and technology.
  • Represent the customer’s voice within the organization, collecting and analyzing feedback to identify recurring challenges and improvement opportunities.
  • Dedicate 10% of your time to process improvement, redesigning workflows, and implementing enhancements to improve efficiency, reduce resolution times, and scale operations.
  • Maintain and update the customer knowledge center, ensuring it reflects accurate and up-to-date information based on common inquiries and feedback.
  • Support the Product & Growth teams by structuring and sharing customer insights that inform product development and strategic initiatives.


What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:


  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Senior Consultant – Global Transaction Banking
description:
Join NFQ!


We are a global consulting firm specialized in business, technology, and operations, with over 2,000 professionals across national and international offices. At NFQ, we offer a different consulting model: Flexible | Scalable | Specialized | Client-Centric .


As part of our continuous growth, we are looking for an experienced Senior Consultant with strong expertise in Global Transaction Banking (GTB) to join our team in São Paulo (Hybrid model).


If you are passionate about corporate banking solutions , trade finance , and cash management , and want to lead impactful transformation projects in the financial industry, this opportunity is for you.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead gap analysis, requirements gathering, and validation to define practical solutions and perform comparative assessments with a strategic focus on Global Transaction Banking (GTB) .
  • Drive and support initiatives in:
  • Trade Finance & Working Capital (Documentary Trade, Factoring/Receivables Finance, Supply Chain Finance/Confirming, Export & Agency Finance, Structured Trade).
  • Cash Management (cash pooling, sweeping, virtual accounts, liquidity dashboards).
  • Plan, oversee, and coordinate project deliverables within defined time and cost parameters .
  • Prepare and deliver project reporting to senior management through presentations and executive updates.
  • Coordinate workshops and meetings with internal and external stakeholders for strategic alignment and requirements validation.
  • Define and execute testing initiatives in collaboration with IT teams.
  • Ensure alignment and coordination between Business, IT, Operations, Risk, and other stakeholders to meet client needs.
  • Support change management and successful adoption of new systems or processes.


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Knowledge of PIX (Brazilian instant payments): rules, reconciliation, and immediate settlement.
  • Understanding of Brazilian regulations (BACEN: PIX, TED, DOC) and international trade finance standards .
  • Proven experience participating in the implementation of PIX (Brazil’s instant payment system) , including setup, rules, reconciliation, and immediate settlement.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in financial consulting, institutional or corporate banking , or related sectors.
  • Hands-on expertise in Global Transaction Banking (GTB) with working knowledge in at least one of the following:
  • Trade Finance & Working Capital (Documentary Trade, Supply Chain Finance, Receivables Finance).
  • Cash Management (payments, liquidity, pooling, virtual accounts).
  • Proven skills in requirements gathering, senior-level reporting, IT liaison, and testing .
  • Familiarity with corporate banking platforms such as Finastra, Temenos, Oracle Flexcube, Kyriba, or similar.
  • Experience with digital and API-based GTB solutions .
  • Fluent English (written and spoken).
  • Spanish is a strong plus.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with ERP / Treasury Management Systems (TMS) such as SAP Treasury, Kyriba, Oracle Treasury, or Finastra.
  • Familiarity with process automation (RPA) and liquidity dashboards (Power BI, Tableau).
  • Experience in operational and liquidity risk management .
  • Exposure to cross-border payments, FX, and international trade finance projects .
  • Proficiency in agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), workshop facilitation, and requirements discovery.
  • Relevant certifications such as CPA-20, CTP, CFA ;
    graduate degrees (Master’s or specialization) in Finance, Economics, International Business, or Risk Management.


Preferred Education

  • Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Banking, Accounting, Engineering (Industrial, Systems, Production) — strong foundation in corporate finance, trade finance, and process optimization.
  • Advanced education (Master’s level or specialization) highly valued:
  • Master’s in Finance, Economics, or International Business.

  • Postgraduate degrees in Banking, Treasury, or Risk Management.

A Barentz é uma distribuidora líder global de ingredientes de alto desempenho para ciências biológicas. Fundada em 1953, a Barentz opera em mais de 70 países, com forte presença na Europa e na América do Norte e uma rede em rápido crescimento na América Latina e na Ásia-Pacífico. title: Coordenador De Cobranças
description:
A inovação e o pioneirismo sempre fizeram parte da nossa história, que começou em 1980. Temos o DNA de varejo, já que nascemos da Pernambucanas – marca centenária que sempre contou com os serviços financeiros para apoiar as famílias brasileiras de maneira fácil e democrática. Ao longo dos anos, as soluções evoluíram e se diversificaram, permitindo à Pefisa se consolidar no mercado financeiro.

Somos responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e gestão de produtos como cartões, empréstimo pessoal, seguros e a conta digital, com diferenciais como simplicidade, praticidade e sem burocracia. Prezamos por bons relacionamentos, pelo atendimento próximo e por jogar junto.

Com mais de 5 milhões de clientes ativos e grande relevância na área do varejo, disponibilizamos um amplo portfólio de serviços para pessoas físicas e jurídicas, além de um Banking as a Service (BaaS) para marcas de diversos segmentos. Com isso, adotamos iniciativas inovadoras para clientes e parceiros.

Na Pefisa tudo é simples. Tudo é rápido. Te ajudamos com o que você precisa para realizar seus sonhos ou alavancar seu negócio. E você escolhe como quer conversar, pois nós somos Fígital. Atuamos com a melhor experiência entre o físico e o digital, com nossas plataformas digitais ou através de nossas lojas físicas. Somos a fintech pra gente como a gente.


Coordenador(a) de Cobrança


Estamos buscando um(a) Coordenador(a) de Cobrança experiente para fazer a gestão e aprimorar nossas estratégias de cobrança, visando a recuperação de crédito e o aumento da rentabilidade. O profissional será responsável por liderar e desenvolver uma equipe de analistas e atuar como elo principal entre a empresa e os parceiros externos.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições


  • Ser o(a) principal representante da empresa junto aos parceiros de Call Center e escritórios de cobrança (Escobs), realizando visitas e participando de comitês de resultados.
  • Garantir a precisão das regras e políticas de cobrança estabelecidas.
  • Controlar e avaliar a eficiência das políticas de cobrança, incluindo a ordem de priorização de clientes, segmentação por risco, valores e perfis.
  • Definir estratégias por canal, como telefone, e-mail, SMS, WhatsApp, cartas e autoatendimento digital.
  • Atuar como um agente de transformação de resultados, colaborando com estratégias 'champion x challenger' para o motor de decisão de cobrança.
  • Controlar e acompanhar os KPIs operacionais de Call Center e Escobs, implementando medidas corretivas quando necessário.
  • Criar campanhas de recuperação diferenciadas para clientes com atraso.
  • Ter disponibilidade para viagens, com a necessidade de visitar operações em cidades como Lins e Pederneiras, e os seis escritórios de cobrança localizados em São Paulo.


Requisitos e Qualificações


  • Experiência comprovada no mercado de cobrança, com profundo conhecimento de todo o fluxo de cobrança, como a régua de cobrança e os processos de gestão em call centers e escritórios.
  • Capacidade de analisar indicadores, discutir resultados e desenvolver estratégias de forma autônoma.
  • Ser um(a) profissional com excelente relacionamento interpessoal, que consiga conduzir conversas de forma sênior e represente a empresa com ética e confiança, especialmente ao lidar com os donos dos escritórios parceiros.
  • Visão analítica de resultados e habilidade para trabalhar com números.
  • É essencial que o(a) profissional saiba segmentar a carteira e definir as melhores abordagens para cada tipo de cliente.


Nossos benefícios:

title: Pessoa Arquiteta De Talentos E Experiência (Gerente De Rh Estratégico)
description:
Sobre a vaga

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


Arquiteto(a) de Talentos e Experiência (Gerente de RH Estratégico)

Local: São Paulo - Híbrido

Reporte: Diretoria de Pessoas & Marketing


Sua Missão: Construir o Futuro do Trabalho em Nossa Empresa

Procuramos um Arquiteto de Estratégia de Pessoas que não apenas gerencie, mas desenhe sistemas humanos de alto impacto. Se você é um designer de experiências , um evangelista de People Analytics e se sente frustrado com o RH focado em processos, este é o seu lugar.

Seu desafio será ir além dos ciclos anuais de performance e dos planos de treinamento prontos, construindo um Ecossistema de Crescimento que maximize a capacidade e a evolução contínua dos nossos talentos, utilizando dados para comprovar o valor de cada intervenção.


O Que Você Vai Desenhar (As Principais Entregas):

Aqui, o seu trabalho é transformar o como fazemos Pessoas:

  1. Arquitetura Preditiva do Talento: Saia do R&S reativo. Você vai projetar o Talent Sourcing usando IA e análise preditiva para antecipar as necessidades de habilidades futuras , construindo comunidades de talentos antes que a necessidade bata à porta.
  2. Design da Experiência do Colaborador (EX): Ser o Head Designer de toda a jornada. Desde o prospect até o alumnus , você garantirá que cada interação reforce nossa cultura de alto impacto .
  3. Cultura de Crescimento Contínuo: Evoluir a Performance de "avaliação cíclica" para um Modelo em Tempo Real . Você irá equipar a liderança com ferramentas de Micro-Coaching para focarem na evolução diária das skills , não apenas na nota final.
  4. Ecossistema de Aprendizagem Líquida (LXP): Acabar com o "Plano Anual de T&D". Você desenhará um LXP Personalizado e Just-in-Time , usando dados para mapear Skill Gaps e prover upskilling e reskilling imediatos.
  5. Organização Baseada em Habilidades: Mudar o foco de "cargos" para "capacidades". Você substituirá a Matriz de Competências estática por um Mapa Dinâmico de Habilidades , desenhando sistemas de Mobilidade Interna para alocar talentos flexivelmente em projetos críticos.
  6. Consultoria em Design Organizacional (OD): Atuar como consultor estratégico para a alta liderança.


O Que Esperamos de Você (Seu DNA de Arquiteto):

  • Visão de Arquiteto e Pensamento Sistêmico: Você vê o RH como um sistema interconectado , e não como silos de R&S, T&D e DP.
  • Empatia Algorítmica: Você tem uma cultura analítica forte e usa dados (People Analytics Avançado ) não para controlar, mas para personalizar e humanizar a experiência em escala.
  • Storyteller de Dados: Sua habilidade em negociar e influenciar a alta liderança é superior, traduzindo insights complexos de dados em narrativas de impacto no negócio.
  • Inovação e Lean HR : Você tem coragem para experimentar com rapidez e baixa fidelidade (testar e aprender ) e abandonar o que não funciona (Gestão de Mudança).


Requisitos Técnicos Essenciais (Seu Kit de Ferramentas):

  • Domínio de Design de Experiência do Colaborador (EX Design) e Design Thinking aplicados ao RH.
  • Conhecimento avançado em People Analytics (modelagem preditiva) e visualização de dados.
  • Proficiência em metodologias ágeis de Performance (OKR, Feedback Contínuo ) e Gestão de Mudança Organizacional (PROSCI ou similar) .
  • Conhecimento prático em Design Organizacional (OD) ou Organizational Network Analysis (ONA) é um grande diferencial .


Formação & Certificações Chave:

  • Ensino Superior Completo.
  • Diferencial de Vanguarda: Certificação em Organizational Design (OD) , Behavioral Science ou Coaching de Liderança .


Se você é uma pessoa que está pronta para ir além do operacional e desenhar o futuro da organização, queremos te conhecer. Candidate-se e venha construir nosso ecossistema de talentos.


O Que Oferecemos:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Human Resources Business Partner Manager
description:
About the Team


You’ll be joining a small but mighty People team of four, spread across the U.S. and Brazil. We’re a tight-knit crew that covers Talent Acquisition, People Operations, and other key functions that keep our company running smoothly as we scale.

We move fast, take big swings, and care deeply about building a thoughtful employee experience. Everyone on the team has broad ownership, and we’re the kind of group that figures things out together, learns quickly, and keeps it real along the way. If you’re energized by a high-impact role where no two days look the same, you’ll fit right in.


What is the role?

We are seeking an experienced and strategic HR Business Partner to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to business leaders, driving HR initiatives that support our company's growth, culture, and organizational effectiveness. You will play a critical role in aligning HR strategies with business objectives and ensuring our teams are empowered and engaged.


This role will be hybrid to our São Paulo office, which will require you in office 2-3 days per week.

This is a CLT contract, paid in $BRL.


In this role you'll:

  • Partner with senior leadership and management to develop and implement HR strategies that align with business goals.
  • Design and implement organizational structures that enhance efficiency and support business growth.
  • Coach and develop leaders to build strong leadership capabilities across the organization.
  • Provide expert guidance on organizational design, talent management, employee relations, and performance management.
  • Lead cross-functional projects and work in a matrix environment collaborating with global teams to drive HR initiatives.
  • Drive initiatives related to employee engagement, culture, and talent development.
  • Support leaders through change management, workforce planning, and capability development.
  • Analyze HR metrics and data to identify trends and recommend solutions.
  • Leverage AI tools and technologies to enhance HR processes and decision-making.
  • Ensure compliance with employment laws and internal policies.
  • Act as a point of contact for employee concerns and facilitate effective communication across teams.


What you'll bring:

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience as an HR Business Partner or in a similar strategic HR role.
  • Fluent in English (both written and spoken).
  • Strong interpersonal and influencing skills with the ability to build trusted relationships at all levels in a remote and hybrid environment.
  • Proven experience in organizational design, including org structure development, job architecture, and operating model design.
  • Strong track record in coaching and developing leaders at various levels.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools and technologies in HR processes (e.G., talent analytics, recruitment, or employee engagement).
  • Proven experience supporting a fast-paced, development-driven tech environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects and work in a matrix structure, collaborating effectively with global cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and work autonomously.
  • Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.


Nice to have:

  • Experience working in or with American or international tech companies and also in global companies with strong interaction with headquarters.
  • Knowledge of HRIS systems and analytics tools.
  • Advanced knowledge of organizational design methodologies and frameworks.


Additional details:

At Teachable, we are committed to providing fair and competitive pay (using market data to inform our pay bands), rewarding high performance, and ensuring all employees have the opportunity and ability to impact Teachable’s overall company value. Base salaries will be reviewed at regular intervals throughout the year, typically following performance review cycles currently conducted annually or in conjunction with a promotion.

The SAP AMS Project Manager also drives continuous improvement, governance, and customer satisfaction in a global delivery model.

Service & Project Delivery

Manage day-to-day SAP AMS operations, including incident, problem, change, and service request management.

Oversee delivery of SAP enhancements, small projects, and rollouts within agreed timelines and budgets.

Ensure SLAs, KPIs, and service quality targets are consistently achieved.

Coordinate with SAP Basis, Functional, and Technical teams to resolve issues and deliver solutions.

Drive root cause analysis and preventive measures to reduce recurring incidents.


Stakeholder & Client Management

Act as the primary contact for clients regarding SAP AMS delivery.

Facilitate regular status, governance, and steering committee meetings.

Build and maintain strong business stakeholder relationships across Finance, Supply Chain, and other SAP domains.

Translate business priorities into SAP AMS delivery plans.


Team & Vendor Coordination

Manage onshore/offshore AMS delivery teams across SAP modules (FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, etc.).

Allocate resources and track performance of functional and technical consultants.

Collaborate with third-party vendors for specialized SAP services (e.G., Cloud, S/4HANA, integrations).


Governance, Reporting & Financials

Prepare and deliver monthly/quarterly service performance reports.

Track AMS budgets, contract compliance, and cost optimization initiatives.

Identify and escalate risks/issues with mitigation strategies.


Continuous Improvement & Innovation

Recommend SAP process improvements and automation opportunities.

Support migration, upgrades, or transition projects (e.G., ECC to S/4HANA).

Drive adoption of ITIL best practices, Agile, or DevOps in SAP AMS delivery.



Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, or related field.

7+ years of experience in SAP project/AMS management.

Strong knowledge of SAP modules (FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, etc.) and integration points.

Experience with ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change, Release Management).

Proven track record in managing global/onshore-offshore delivery models.

Excellent client-facing and stakeholder management skills.

PMP, ITIL, or SAP certifications (SAP Solution Manager, Activate, S/4HANA) preferred.


Key Competencies

Deep understanding of SAP AMS operating model.

Strong leadership and team coordination skills.

Analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making ability.

Customer-first mindset with service excellence orientation.

Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

title: Solution Architect Specialist
description:
Job Title – Solution Architect Specialist

TITTLE: Solution Architect Specialist (D2)

Location: São Paulo – Villa Lobos

Flexible Working / Hybrid – Office and Remote combination


Why join BT International?

BT International is looking for an experienced Solution Architect Specialist to join our Customer Solutions & Design team. This is a unique opportunity to play a pivotal role in architecting complex, high-impact solutions for our global customers — and ensuring that what we sell is what we deliver, right the first time.


Why this role matters

As a Solution Architect Specialist, you’ll act as the trusted advisor for strategic customers, shaping innovative solutions across multiple technology domains — from networking and cloud to security, collaboration, and AI. You’ll be accountable for the end-to-end solution lifecycle, working closely with sales, delivery, and service teams to drive exceptional outcomes.

This is more than a technical role — it’s a leadership position where your expertise, collaboration, and commercial acumen will directly influence BT International’s growth and reputation.


What you’ll do

  • Lead solution architecture for complex, customized, multi-technology environments — ensuring they are technically sound, commercially viable, and executable.
  • Translate customer business requirements into fit-for-purpose, scalable solutions that balance feasibility, cost, and profitability.
  • Own the solution lifecycle across pre-sales, proposal development, and early delivery, ensuring alignment with scope, risk management, and governance standards.
  • Partner with sales teams to develop compelling proposals, statements of work, and customer contracts.
  • Represent BT in strategic customer meetings, presenting solutions with impact and confidence at executive level.
  • Collaborate with virtual cross-functional teams (sales, bid, product, delivery, and service design) to ensure end-to-end solution clarity and deliverability.
  • Assess and manage scope changes during delivery to maintain alignment with cost, time, and quality objectives.
  • Contribute to BT’s market leadership by developing reusable solution components and accelerators, and by staying ahead of emerging trends (e.G., AI, advanced cloud, and digital workplace solutions).

What we’re looking for

  • Proven experience (10+ years) in pre-sales, solution architecture, or technical leadership within complex IT environments.
  • Track record of success in large, global sales opportunities, supporting revenue growth and delivery excellence.
  • Strong expertise in multi-domain solution design across:
  • Digital Infrastructure (Cloud, WAN, SDWAN, LAN, WiFi, Security)
  • Digital Workplace (Collaboration, Contact Centres)
  • Emerging technologies (AI, automation)
  • Skilled in proposal development, estimation, and scope definition, with the ability to identify risks and dependencies.
  • Strong commercial acumen — able to balance customer needs with business objectives, protect scope, and identify cross-sell/up-sell opportunities.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills;
    confident engaging withsenior executives and simplifying complex concepts.
  • A leadership mindset: proactive, accountable, and able to guide cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • A continuous improvement approach: curious, innovative, and passionate about raising the bar in solution quality and delivery.


What you’ll get

  • The chance to work with a global portfolio of strategic customers.
  • A hybrid, flexible work environment.
  • Competitive package with opportunities for professional growth and leadership development.
  • Be part of a team where things just work… Better on BT.

title: Senior Business Continuity Analyst
description:
Purpose of the Position

An Asian financial institution, recognized as one of the largest and among the leading banks worldwide, with a strong presence across the Americas, Europe, and Asia. In Brazil, the institution focuses on corporate and investment banking, providing clients with tailored financial solutions.


With a global reputation for stability and long-term relationships, the institution continues to invest in innovation, cybersecurity, and sustainability, reinforcing its commitment to responsible growth and the protection of client interests in a rapidly evolving financial landscape.


The main idea of this role is to protect the institution’s ability to deliver critical banking services during disruption by owning and advancing the BCM – Business Continuity Management program processes. This is a hands-on, orchestration-heavy position that translates global continuity standards into effective local execution and audit-ready evidence.

Concretely, the role:

  • Leads the BCM lifecycle end-to-end: conducts BIAs (criticality, dependencies, RTO/RPO), maintains BCPs, and plans/coordinates tests (e.G., DR/switch-over validations, contingency site, VDI/endpoint readiness, evacuation drills, call tree), including out-of-hours windows.
  • Turns results into decisions: surfaces risks, residual exposures, and disclaimers to risk committees;
    drives lessons learned and closes open issues with robust documentation and owners/dates/evidence.
  • Connects BCM to the broader non-financial risk picture: interfaces with Operational Incidents, Vendor Risk, Products & Services, and RCSA so that continuity risks and control gaps are consistently identified, tracked, and remediated.
  • Bridges global and local: adapts global policy/standards to Brazil’s context, ensuring regulatory fit (BACEN) without diluting control integrity.
  • Influences without formal authority: engages senior stakeholders (e.G., Treasury and Operations leaders) to prioritize continuity activities, align on test windows, and validate outcomes;
    partners with IT/IS to validate DR without performing technical changes.


Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Operate the existing Business Continuity framework while continuously improving its maturity, expanding coverage, and strengthening evidence quality.
  • Organize and document activities using spreadsheets and manual controls, ensuring that all records are audit-ready and compliant with internal and external requirements.
  • Plan, coordinate, and lead continuity tests, including out-of-hours exercises, anticipating risks, resolving issues on the spot, and making sound, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Adapt global policies and methodologies to the Brazilian regulatory context, maintaining alignment with global standards and full compliance with BACEN requirements.
  • Engage and influence critical business areas, such as Treasury and Operations, to secure collaboration and prioritization of BCM activities without direct authority.
  • Map critical processes, conduct Business Impact Analyses (BIA), and maintain updated Business Continuity Plans (BCP).
  • Develop, update, and review continuity policies, standards, and procedures, while supporting the management of open issues, regulatory requirements, and action plans.
  • Deliver training to teams and managers on continuity and disaster recovery procedures, proactively monitor external events and news for potential risks
  • This role will also involve executing other operational risk programs such as Operational Incident Management, Vendor/Product & Service Risk Management, etc.


Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • Bring solid experience gained over several years in financial institutions, with a proven track record in Business Continuity Management, including BIA, BCP, and continuity testing.
  • Demonstrate strong knowledge of operational resilience practices, with exposure to RCSA, operational incident management, and vendor/third-party risk.
  • Be comfortable coordinating with IT and Information Security (IS) teams during disaster recovery validations, leading and validating outcomes without performing the technical execution.
  • Possess proficiency in Excel for data analysis and tracking, and PowerPoint for building clear, executive-level presentations and reports.
  • Communicate effectively in English at a level to interact with global stakeholders and follow corporate standards.
  • Hold a degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems/Computer Science, Risk Management, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of Bank Policies and Regulations, familiarity with cyber risk policies, procedures, and regulations, and the ability to review and ensure compliance with these requirements (Differential). Bring additional exposure to ISO 22301 standards, experience with tools such as Visio or Power BI/Power Query, and professional certifications in business continuity or disaster recovery (e.G., CBCP, DRII, BRCCI). (Differential)


Behavioral Skills

  • Executive communication & influence – Engages effectively with senior stakeholders, articulates complex topics in a clear, concise manner, and secures alignment in risk committees.
  • Proactivity & ownership – Demonstrates a self-starter mindset, acting hands-on and taking full responsibility for driving initiatives to completion.
  • Organization, discipline & critical thinking – Maintains audit-ready documentation with rigor and structure, while applying analytical thinking and sound judgment to make timely, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Collaboration & resilience – Partners seamlessly with Non-Tech areas and IT/IS, showing adaptability and composure under pressure, and adjusting course when unexpected challenges arise.

description:

Será responsável por coordenar um analista sênior, interagir constantemente com a área de negócios e desenvolver controles, processos e indicadores para dar suporte a uma operação complexa que envolve importação, estoque e vendas no mercado nacional, bem como operações de exportação de minérios de aço e manganês.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Gestão da equipe: liderar e desenvolver um analista sênior, garantindo entrega de análises consistentes e dentro dos prazos;
  • Exposição cambial e financeira: monitorar riscos de câmbio da operação de aço (exposição natural, NDFs, marcação a mercado) e acompanhar a efetividade dos hedges contratados;
  • Gestão de estoques: controlar o aging, volumes, custos médios e variações, além de realizar marcação a mercado e análises de giro e rentabilidade por produto;
  • Apuração de resultado gerencial: elaborar e validar o resultado da operação, garantindo conciliação com a contabilidade e confiabilidade das informações para as DFs;
  • Análise de performance: desenvolver e acompanhar KPIs do negócio (margem, rentabilidade, giro de estoque, exposição financeira, etc.), propondo melhorias e alternativas de otimização;
  • Interação com áreas de negócio: atuar como parceiro da operação de aço, garantindo alinhamento com a equipe comercial e logística quanto a margens, custos e riscos;
  • Projetos e melhorias: implementar novos controles e processos em conjunto com a controladoria corporativa, promovendo maior robustez e agilidade na gestão;


Requisitos necessários para essa função:

  • Superior Completo em Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
    pós-graduação/MBA será um diferencial;
  • Inglês fluente;
  • Conhecimento sólido em operações de comércio exterior e em mercado financeiro/cambial (exposição, NDFs, hedge);
  • Forte domínio de ferramentas de análise de dados: Excel avançado, Power BI e Power Query;
    conhecimento em SQL é diferencial;
  • Capacidade analítica, visão crítica e habilidade de transformar dados em insights acionáveis.
  • Boa comunicação e postura de business partner, capaz de dialogar com áreas comerciais e diretoria;

title: Seller Governance Specialist
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future.


ABOUT THE ROLE

This person will be responsible for representing the local market and aligning with the headquarters team on governance policies for the Brazilian marketplace. This role balances effective seller management with business growth considerations and seller feedback, aiming to enhance sellers’ understanding and acceptance of platform governance policies, reduce compliance risks, and ensure a fair, efficient, and sustainable marketplace.


Responsibilities


  • Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, and the HQ Governance team to develop and update seller governance policies and guidelines, ensuring alignment with seller management needs and local market requirements.
  • Regularly monitor and analyze seller violation data to identify anomalies and areas for policy improvement, and drive continuous enhancements.
  • Collect and address seller feedback, strengthen seller education and training, and foster strong relationships to promote transparency, trust, and accountability.
  • Partner cross-functionally with internal teams to continuously optimize platform operations and governance mechanisms.


Requirements


  • Bachelor's degree in business
  • Strong understanding of e-commerce, online marketplaces, and seller dynamics
  • Familiarity with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
  • Self-starter, a fast learner who has critical thinking
  • English is mandatory, Mandarin is a plus


At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

title: Jr. Risk & Markets Consultant
description:
Join NFQ!


We are a global consulting firm specialized in business, technology, and operations, with over 2,000 professionals across national and international offices. At NFQ, we offer a different consulting model: Flexible | Scalable | Specialized | Client-Centric .


As part of our continuous growth, we are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Jr. Risk & Markets Consultant to join our Markets & Treasury Risk Team in São Paulo (Hybrid model).

If you are passionate about market risk analysis, data quality, and financial controls , and want to work at the core of risk management processes , this is the right opportunity for you.


What You’ll Do

  • Validate and reconcile financial market data used by front-office and risk teams (prices, volumes, rates, market variables).
  • Monitor, calculate, and report market risk metrics such as sensitivities (Greeks), exposures, Value at Risk (VaR) , and internal limits.
  • Perform variance and P&L analysis , comparing estimates vs. actual results to identify inconsistencies or potential risk events.
  • Support the creation and automation of risk reports and dashboards for decision-making by Risk and Treasury.
  • Collaborate with Front Office, Middle Office, and Back Office to resolve discrepancies and ensure data integrity for risk models.
  • Assist in the development of scripts or tools for risk data validation and control automation (Python, SQL, R).
  • Participate in data integrity tests , stress scenarios, and contribute to internal control and compliance processes.


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics , or related fields.
  • Strong quantitative and analytical foundation, with solid knowledge of probability, statistics, and numerical methods .
  • Advanced Excel skills (complex formulas, pivot tables, lookups, data validation).
  • Basic programming or scripting skills (Python, R, SQL, or similar ) applied to risk or data analysis.
  • Advanced Spanish or English (daily communication with LATAM stakeholders).
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and rigorous when working with large financial datasets .
  • 1 to 3 years of experience (internship or full-time) in risk, market analysis, or financial environments .


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in market risk or related areas (trading desk support, risk control, or model validation).
  • Knowledge of derivatives, fixed income, FX, and interest rate products .
  • Familiarity with risk frameworks (VaR, stress testing, backtesting, sensitivity analysis).
  • Experience with Python analytical libraries (Pandas, NumPy).
  • Advanced English for global projects and documentation.
  • Certifications or training in FRM, CFA , or specific risk management programs.
  • Knowledge of BI / data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.) and version control tools (Git).


What We Offer

  • Exposure to market risk management projects and strategic financial decision-making.
  • Work in a dynamic and international environment with leading financial institutions.
  • Continuous learning and official certifications (risk, technology, and finance).
  • Language classes to boost your global career.
  • A personalized development plan with mentorship and growth opportunities.


CLT contract benefits:

  • Health & dental insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Meal voucher
  • Transportation allowance
  • VR R$ 800,00
  • Free English and Spanish Lessons
  • Flexible work environment, internal events, travel opportunities, and wellness initiatives.



Learn more about us: nfq.Es | LinkedIn NFQ

title: Especialista De Solução De Dados
description:
NOSSAS PESSOAS, JUNTAS, LIDERAM COM CONSCIÊNCIA.

das experiências marcantes dos serviços de beleza da Bluma e da nossa plataforma de educação financeira, a Emana Pay. Marcas e serviços relevantes para quem os utiliza e reconhecidos pelo nosso compromisso com a condução de negócios regenerativos.


Função

Prazo indeterminado


O que você vai fazer por aqui?

Profissional responsável por atuar como elo estratégico entre as áreas de negócio e os times técnicos de dados. Essa pessoa será responsável por entender profundamente as necessidades do negócio e propor soluções baseadas em dados, alinhadas às diretrizes de governança e arquitetura da organização.


Quais conhecimentos e vivências você vai precisar para compartilhar com a nossa rede?

  • Ser o ponto de contato inicial para entendimento de novas demandas de dados trazidas pelas áreas de negócio ao Hub de Dados;
  • Realizar a análise e qualificação das demandas junto às áreas de negócio, atuando em parceria com os BRMs (Business Relationship Managers) para garantir sinergia e clareza nas soluções propostas;
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em solução de dados, envolvendo as disciplinas de dados adequadas (engenharia de dados, análise de dados, ciência de dados e governança de dados);
  • Ser o elo entreo time técnico (analistas, engenheiros de dados, cientistas de dados) e as demais áreas da companhia, garantindo comunicação fluida e entendimento mútuo;
  • Apoiar na estimativa de esforço (prazo e custo) das demandas, considerando impacto, complexidade e viabilidade técnica;
  • Identificar e mapear os domínios e disciplinas de dados relacionados a cada iniciativa;
  • Estar próximo das áreas de negócio para compreender seus desafios e oportunidades, propondo soluções orientadas a dados que tragam valor real;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de melhoria contínua na jornada de dados e fomentar uma cultura data-driven na organização;
  • Atuar como referência técnica e comportamental dentro do time, promovendo boas práticas, cultura de dados, colaboração e estimular a autonomia e protagonismo dos membros da equipe.


Quais os requisitos?

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração de Empresas, Engenharias, Tecnologia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento emconceitos de Data Mesh e modelo de Operação Hub Spoke;
  • Conhecimento emferramentas de visualização e modelação de dados;
  • Capacidade de levantamento de requisitos de negócio;
  • Comunicação eficaz e habilidade em negociação;
  • Storytelling e experiência em montar e conduzir apresentações;
  • Gestão de conflitos.


Quais os diferencias?

  • Inglês e/ou Espanhol avançado.


O que você vai encontrar por aqui?

Somos mais do que um lugar de trabalho: construímos e vivemos diariamente o Ecossistema Bem Estar Bem, baseado na relação harmoniosa entre cada indivíduo, as relações ao seu redor e o ambiente em que está inserido. Além de oferecer benefícios voltados ao bem-estar social, físico, financeiro, mental e emocional, promovemos um ambiente de prosperidade, pertencimento e propósito, fortalecendo uma rede sólida de apoio, expansão de consciência e respeito à diversidade, equidade e inclusão.

Somos um movimento que transforma a maneira de viver e fazer negócios em 14 países da América Latina, sempre guiados por consciência.


Conhece alguma pessoa aqui na Natura?

Se sim, peça o e-mail corporativo dessa pessoa e, ao se inscrever para uma vaga, utilize-o para solicitar uma recomendação. É uma excelente oportunidade para fortalecer sua rede de contatos e avançar no seu processo seletivo em nossa empresa!


A Natura celebra e abraça a diversidade em todas as suas formas e pluralidades.

Convidamos #Mulheres, #PessoasNegras, #PessoasComDeficiência, pessoas da comunidade #LGBTQIA+, #Gestantes e pessoas com #50anos+ a se candidatarem para esta vaga!

title: Events Specialist
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Events Specialist to spearhead our presence and engagement initiatives within the local market. This role is crucial in building and nurturing strong relationships with key organizations, particularly shopping malls and local businesses, to drive brand visibility, foster community ties, and support our strategic objectives, including the growth of the SHEIN Marketplace. The ideal candidate will be an exceptional communicator, a meticulous planner, and a proactive relationship builder with a proven track record in event management and stakeholder engagement.


Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Relationship Management:

  • Develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key external organizations, including shopping malls, local businesses, industry associations, and community groups.
  • Identify and cultivate new partnership opportunities that align with SHEIN's regional goals and brand values.
  • Act as the primary point of contact and ambassador for SHEIN in regional interactions, ensuring consistent brand messaging and positive representation.

Event Planning & Execution:

  • Design, plan, and execute a diverse portfolio of regional events, activations, and promotional projects, often in collaboration with other partners.
  • Oversee all logistical aspects of events, including venue selection, vendor coordination, staffing, permits, and materials.
  • Ensure all events are meticulously organized, on-brand, and deliver an exceptional experience for attendees and partners.

Budget Management & Optimization:

  • Develop, manage, and meticulously track budgets for all events and partnership initiatives, ensuring cost-effectiveness and adherence to financial guidelines.
  • Negotiate contracts with vendors and partners to secure favorable terms and maximize ROI.
  • Provide regular financial reporting and analysis on event expenditures.

Regional Representation & Communication:

  • Represent SHEIN at regional industry events, meetings, and community gatherings, networking effectively to enhance brand perception and uncover new opportunities.
  • Develop and deliver compelling presentations about SHEIN's initiatives (e.G., Marketplace, new campaigns) to various external stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with internal marketing and communications teams to ensure consistent messaging and promotion of regional activities.

Project Management:

  • Lead and manage complex projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders, such as setting up stands, events, or joint marketing campaigns with shopping malls / industry associations.
  • Develop detailed project plans, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring projects are completed on time and within scope.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate risks, and implement solutions to challenges that arise during planning or execution.

Reporting & Analysis:

  • Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) for all events and partnerships, providing comprehensive post-event reports and insights.
  • Utilize data to evaluate the success of initiatives and inform future strategy development.

Local Travel:

  • Frequent local travel within the designated region will be required to attend meetings and oversee event execution.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, Event Management, Public Relations, or a related field.
  • 5 years of proven experience in event management, community relations, and/or partnership development, preferably within retail, e-commerce, or a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing budgets, negotiating contracts, and optimizing resources for events.
  • Strong track record of building and nurturing successful relationships with diverse organizations and stakeholders.
  • Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives concurrently, from conception to completion.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with proven ability to deliver engaging presentations.
  • Proactive, results-oriented, and highly organized with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently, make sound decisions, and adapt to a dynamic work environment.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and Mandarim is mandatory.
  • Fluency in English is a plus.
  • Willingness and ability to travel locally as required.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in the e-commerce or fashion retail industry.
  • Familiarity with the regional market landscape, including key shopping centers and local organizations.
  • Experience presenting to large groups or external partners.


At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - Latam
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone.
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional.

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others.

Who you are

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous benefits package
  • Paid Time Off
  • Career developmental opportunities
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development

Please note, all offers presented to candidates are carefully crafted to ensure market competitiveness, equity, and reflect the individual candidate’s education, experience, skills and potential.
Hunter Douglas is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with applicable employment laws. EOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled are encouraged to apply.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
About Trace Finance

Trace Finance empowers global payment enterprises to seamlessly move money across borders and access stablecoins with ease. With over $5 billion USD in processed volume, we provide the infrastructure that enables instant settlement, regulatory clarity, and best-in-class FX and crypto on/off ramps. We're building the future of cross-border payments and digital asset infrastructure.

The Role

We're seeking a talented mid-level Platform Engineer (DevOps Engineer) to join our infrastructure team. While we prefer candidates who can work from our office for better collaboration and team integration, we also offer remote work flexibility. You'll be instrumental in building and maintaining the cloud infrastructure and automation systems that power our global payment platform. This is an opportunity to work on mission-critical infrastructure that supports billions in transaction volume and ensures 24/7 availability for our financial services.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS to support high-volume financial transactions
  • Build and manage CI/CD pipelines to enable rapid, reliable software deployments
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform for consistent, reproducible environments
  • Deploy, configure, and optimize Kubernetes clusters for containerized workloads
  • Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions to ensure system reliability
  • Automate operational tasks and improve deployment processes to increase team efficiency
  • Collaborate with development teams to optimize application performance and reliability
  • Ensure security best practices across all infrastructure components
  • Participate in on-call rotation to maintain 24/7 system availability
  • Document infrastructure architecture, runbooks, and operational procedures
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure issues in production environments
Requirements
  • 3-5 years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering roles
  • Strong problem-solving skills and systematic approach to troubleshooting
  • Ability to work independently whether in office or remote settings
  • Passion for automation, reliability, and operational excellence
  • Interest in financial technology and innovation
  • PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) registration or willingness to obtain
Required Technical Skills
  • Cloud Platforms: Strong hands-on experience with AWS services (EC2, ECS/EKS, RDS, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, etc.)
  • Container Orchestration: Proven expertise with Kubernetes (deployment, scaling, troubleshooting)
  • Infrastructure as Code: Proficiency with Terraform for managing cloud resources
  • CI/CD: Experience building and maintaining pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar)
  • Scripting: Strong scripting skills in Bash, Python, or similar languages
  • Containerization: Solid understanding of Docker and container best practices
  • Networking: Understanding of networking concepts, load balancers, DNS, and security groups
  • Monitoring & Observability: Experience with tools like Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or CloudWatch
  • Version Control: Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows
  • Basic English proficiency (required for documentation and team communication)
Nice-to-Have Technical Skills
  • Experience with microservices architecture and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)
  • Database administration experience (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis)
  • Message queue systems (AWS SNS, SQS, Kafka)
  • Security and compliance tools (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, security scanning)
  • Experience with financial systems and high-availability requirements
  • Advanced Kubernetes features (operators, custom resources, Helm)
  • GitOps practices and tools (ArgoCD, Flux)
  • Performance tuning and capacity planning
  • Cost optimization strategies for cloud infrastructure
  • Intermediate English proficiency
Essential Soft Skills
  • Proactive mindset - Identify potential issues before they become problems
  • Self-learner - Stay current with evolving DevOps tools and practices
  • Critical thinking - Analyze complex systems and design elegant solutions
  • Self-management - Prioritize work effectively and manage your time independently
  • Team collaboration - Work effectively with engineering teams across different time zones
  • Commitment - Dedicated to maintaining system reliability and meeting SLAs
  • Versatility - Adapt to new technologies and changing infrastructure needs
  • Communication - Clearly document and explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
What We Offer
  • Flexible work arrangement (office preferred, remote possible)
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge fintech and blockchain infrastructure
  • Build and maintain systems that process billions in transaction volume
  • Collaborative, innovative team environment with strong engineering culture
  • Professional growth opportunities in cloud technologies and DevOps practices
  • Exposure to both traditional finance and cryptocurrency ecosystems
  • Impact the reliability and scalability of global payment infrastructure
  • Work with modern tools and technologies in a forward-thinking organization


Ready to build world-class infrastructure? Join us at Trace Finance and be part of the team that powers the future of cross-border transactions and digital assets.

Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.


Procuramos Cientista de Dados que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Principais Responsabilidades:


Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento (P&D): Conduzir análises exploratórias complexas e desenvolver modelos preditivos e prescritivos para resolver desafios de negócio, desde a otimização de processos até a criação de novos produtos.

Governança de IA e MLOps: Definir, implantar e operacionalizar a governança para todo o ciclo de vida de projetos de Ciência de Dados em ambiente cloud, incluindo a implementação de esteiras de MLOps para automação, monitoramento e versionamento de modelos.

Liderança Técnica e Mentoria: Atuar como referência técnica para a equipe, fornecendo suporte a outros cientistas e engenheiros de dados, disseminando conhecimento e garantindo a aplicação das melhores práticas e padrões de desenvolvimento.

Arquitetura de Soluções de Dados: Projetar e documentar a arquitetura de soluções de IA configurando ambientes e ferramentas em cloud (preferencialmente Azure) e produzindo templates e aceleradores para otimizar a entrega de projetos.

Colaboração com Stakeholders: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as áreas de negócio para entender suas necessidades, traduzir requisitos em especificações técnicas e apresentar os resultados e o valor gerado pelas soluções de forma clara e executiva.

Inovação Contínua: Avaliar e testar novas tecnologias, frameworks e tendências do mercado de IA (ex: Deep Learning, Processamento de Linguagem Natural, Análise de dados de IoT) para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e inovação.


Competências Técnicas :


Linguagens e Ferramentas: Proficiência em Python e/ou R para análise e modelagem de dados.

Machine Learning e Deep Learning: Sólida experiência com bibliotecas como Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch e Keras. Conhecimento prático em técnicas de regressão, classificação, clusterização, séries temporais, Text Analytics (NLP) e visão computacional.

Plataformas de Cloud: Experiência hands-on com serviços de IA em nuvem, especialmente Azure Machine Learning. Conhecimento em Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics e/ou serviços equivalentes em AWS ou GCP é um diferencial.

Bancos de Dados e Big Data: Domínio de estruturas de bancos de dados (Relacional e NoSQL), linguagem SQL e experiência com tecnologias de Big Data como Hadoop, Spark ou MapReduce.

MLOps e Governança: Conhecimento em práticas de DevOps para IA (MLOps), incluindo versionamento de código (Git), CI/CD para modelos e monitoramento da performance em produção. Familiaridade com frameworks de governança corporativa de IA.

Visualização de Dados: Habilidade para criar dashboards e relatórios interativos utilizando ferramentas como Power BI, Tableau ou bibliotecas como Matplotlib e Seaborn.


Certificações (Desejável):

Certificação: Apresentar pelo menos uma certificação relevante em cloud ou dados (ex: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate).


Diferenciais :

Experiência com dados de IoT, especialmente em ambientes industriais ou de manufatura.

Conhecimento em mais de uma plataforma de cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP).

Experiência prévia no setor de atuação da empresa (ex: mineração, finanças, varejo).

Contribuições para a comunidade de tecnologia (ex: projetos open-source no GitHub, artigos em blogs, palestras em eventos).

Inglês avançado/fluente para colaboração com times globais.


Formação:

Formação Acadêmica: Formação superior completa nas áreas mencionadas.

Qualificação Avançada: Pós-graduação, MBA ou Mestrado em Ciência de Dados, Inteligência Artificial ou área afim. Certificações de nível Expert ou Specialty (e.G., Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty).


O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.

  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

title: Desenvolvedor(A) Gis
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS).
